moworks.notes: Card (80 % x 52 %, r8) over a red DELETE zone. In a 700 ms pass: rest to 10 %; x +60 px, rotate 4°, opacity 0.85 at 55 % (finger drag); then accelerating (cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)) to x +190 px (out of frame), rotate 10°, opacity 0 at 82 %; holds gone. Recipe: release past 35 % of the width flies out, otherwise it springs back to 0. Params: drag (60 px) · exit (190 px) · tilt (4° → 10°) · duration (0.7 s). Released past 35 % of the width it flies out (cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)), tilting 4° → 10°; otherwise it would spring back.
